coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: rules, squares, row lines and caption clusters found in each embedded JPEG at its own resolution (b030-geom, picx.py); converted to PDF points through the drawing matrix; every picture looked at; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Subscription agreement (VII Peaks Co-Optivist Income BDC II), printed from a browser in landscape: six form pages, each a picture split over two PDF pages. Owner and joint owner initial representations a-t and sign page A-3; the custodian signs if applicable; the broker-dealer signs A-4; trustees sign Appendix A; the entity secretary signs Appendix B. No issuer acceptance block.
signing.note: Pictures are 893x1155 px at 0.75 pt/px drawn at x 61.5; the first PDF page shows picture rows 0-741, the second the rest. Places cut by the break are on both pages, marked.
